zh: `docs/SETTINGS.md` 与 `docs/SETTINGS.en.md` 只留设置页自己的内容——六个分页与各档、设置项之间的依赖、跨功能的几段说明——动效各自做什么由链接指向功能一览。
en: `docs/SETTINGS.md` and `docs/SETTINGS.en.md` carry the settings page's own content — the six tabs and their tiers, the dependencies between rows, the cross-cutting notes — and link to the feature list for what each effect does.
